title: Prop edges in edges_log never get their box score: ingestPropResults only covers `picks`, player_logs refreshed only pre-game
device: code review + scratch pipeline (no UI repro possible: demo DB has no props)
steps: Read settleEdges: for market=prop it reads player_logs for (sport, player, stat, game date) and voids after 24h if absent
Find who writes player_logs: refreshPlayerLogs (pre-game, skipped if the player has a log < 2 days old) and ingestPropResults (loops over `picks` only, never edges_log)
So an NBA prop edge that is logged in edges_log but not published as a pick gets no post-game box score
expected: Every logged NBA prop edge (points, rebounds, assists, threes, PRA) is graded from that game's box score after it goes final
actual: Only the pre-game history fetch writes logs; the game's own stat line is fetched post-game only for published picks. Prop edges for players with a recent log (back-to-back, regular starters) have no row for the game date, so they settle 'void' after 24h. Applies to all prop markets, not just blocks/steals/turnovers (guess: depends on whether provider's pre-game 20-game fetch ever includes the just-played game).
evidence: Code reading only; demo DB has no props so not reproducible end to end.
suspected_area: ingestPropResults should also iterate unsettled prop rows from edges_log; refreshPlayerLogs 2-day skip
